description: Vet a U.S. motor carrier from FMCSA SAFER data: operating authority, safety rating, insurance on file, driver and vehicle out-of-service rates, and FreightFA's risk flags. Search by USDOT number, MC number, or carrier name (give one). Data is cached for 24 hours. Does not count toward the estimate allowance.

dot_number.description: USDOT number, digits only, or null.

mc_number.description: MC/MX docket number, digits only, or null.

name.description: Carrier legal or DBA name, or null.

name: lookup_carrier
title: Look up a motor carrier (FMCSA)
